metadata.title: The Secret Second Phone
metadata.subtitle: On our anniversary night, his hidden phone lit up at 11:42 PM.

nodes.text: 11:42 PM · Our 3rd anniversary. Marcus is in the shower when a sleek black phone buzzes inside his coat pocket.
Did she fall asleep yet? I'm waiting in the penthouse.
Wait... Marcus never told me he had a second phone.
Stop stalling, Marcus. Tonight is the last night before the board votes.

nodes.caption: Hotel Aurelia · Room 4208. Bring the signed papers.

nodes.text: Your hands tremble. The phone screen suddenly flashes bright red.
You hit Answer on mute. A familiar woman's voice whispers: 'Marcus, tell Claire the marriage is over—I want the signature by noon.'
You decline the call. Instantly, an auto-transcribed voicemail pops up: 'Marcus, tell Claire it's over—bring the papers by noon.'

nodes.prompt: The shower just stopped. The door handle turns. What do you do?

options.label: Snap a photo of the screen & hide it
Crack his locked vault (PIN 0714)

nodes.text: You photograph the keycard message with your own phone and slip the burner back into his pocket.
Room 4208... Tomorrow I'll see who 'V' really is with my own eyes.
SECRET UNLOCKED: PIN 0714 opens a hidden folder—a $4.2M wire draft co-signed by YOUR sister, Vanessa.
Vanessa?! 'V' is my own sister?! And that's my late father's trust fund!
You AirDrop the PDF to your phone and drop the burner back into his coat pocket just as the door opens.
Hey babe... why are you standing there holding my coat?
Just hanging it up, darling. Happy anniversary.

nodes.headline: His Coat Pocket Buzzes Again...
nodes.teaser_text: Episode 2: Marcus reaches for his coat—and you catch a deadly slip from the person you trusted most.

nodes.text: 8:15 AM · The Next Morning. Marcus kissed your forehead and rushed out for an 'emergency board call.'
Forgot to tell you—don't wait up for lunch. Investors are flying in from Zurich.
Of course. Good luck with the 'investors.'
You open your chat with Vanessa. Time to set a trap.
Hey sis! Want to grab brunch near Hotel Aurelia at 11?
Ugh, can't today! Why Aurelia? Their penthouse elevators are under maintenance anyway lol.
How would you know the penthouse elevators are under maintenance, Vanessa?
Saw it on Instagram! Gotta run, talk tonight 😘
11:10 AM · A private investigator friend texts you a live photo from the Hotel Aurelia lobby.

nodes.caption: 11:08 AM · Marcus stepping into the VIP lift with a woman in a crimson coat.

nodes.prompt: You're two blocks from Hotel Aurelia. What's your move?

options.label: Head straight up to the 42nd floor
options.player_reply_text: I'm not waiting another second. I'm going up.

options.label: Unlock Marcus's cloud backup first
options.player_reply_text: Let's see what they've been hiding in the cloud.

nodes.text: You flash your family VIP black card at the concierge and step into the private penthouse lift.
Thinking about you, love. Picking up white roses on my way back. 🌹
SECRET UNLOCKED: You access Marcus's synced iPad cloud—finding a scanned equity transfer with YOUR forged signature!
They didn't just betray me... they forged my signature to steal Dad's company.
You download the forged contract as evidence and take the VIP lift straight to the 42nd floor.
DING. Floor 42. You step out into the marble hallway—and stop cold outside Room 4208.

nodes.headline: Voices Behind Room 4208
nodes.teaser_text: Episode 3: You press your ear to the door—and hear a third voice you never expected.

nodes.text: 11:29 AM · Outside Room 4208. Muffled arguing echoes through the heavy oak door.
Just left the boardroom! Traffic is crazy, see you at 1?
Funny. You sound like you're standing three feet away from me.
Dead silence on the other side of the door. Then your phone vibrates violently.
Vanessa whispers frantically: 'Claire, DO NOT come inside! Marcus doesn't know I'm wired—he's been blackmailing me!'
CLAIRE STOP!! Don't knock! Marcus is forcing me to sign—he threatened to destroy your father's estate!

nodes.prompt: Is Vanessa telling the truth—or playing you both? Act now!

options.label: Bang on the door & confront them
options.player_reply_text: Open the door, Marcus. Both of you.

options.label: Use spare keycard & record secretly

nodes.text: You pound on Room 4208. Footsteps scramble—and Marcus yanks the door open, pale as a ghost.
Claire—listen to me! This isn't what it looks like!
SECRET UNLOCKED: You swipe the concierge passkey silently and hit Record. Inside, Marcus isn't threatening Vanessa—they're clinking champagne glasses!
Vanessa laughs: 'Relax, Claire always believes my tears. Once the wire clears at noon, we're on the jet.'
Save the champagne. You're both going to prison.
On the glass table sits the open briefcase, the burner phone, and a live bank transfer countdown: 00:27:45.

nodes.headline: 27 Minutes Until $4.2M Vanishes
nodes.teaser_text: Episode 4: Expose their forged contract before noon—and uncover the hidden mastermind behind the burner phone.

nodes.text: 11:34 AM · Inside Room 4208. Marcus steps between you and the briefcase while Vanessa backs toward the balcony.
Claire, please! He said if I didn't help him, he'd bankrupt the whole family!
Nice try, Vanessa. You were the one who brought me the forged deed!

nodes.caption: Exhibit A · Trust Fund Transfer ($4,200,000) — Forged Signature

nodes.text: Save your lies. I already have the hotel keycard, the CCTV, and the forged signature.

nodes.prompt: The wire executes in 20 minutes. How do you finish this?

options.label: Freeze the bank wire & call police
options.player_reply_text: Hello, Fraud Desk? Freeze account 8841 immediately.

options.label: Broadcast confession live to the Board
options.player_reply_text: Say hello to the entire Board of Directors, Marcus.

nodes.text: The bank locks the $4.2M wire on speakerphone. Hotel security knocks at the door with two detectives.
You think I'm the one running this?! Check the burner phone, Claire! Look at who sent the money!
SECRET UNLOCKED: You connect to the emergency Board Zoom on speaker. Twelve directors hear Marcus and Vanessa blame each other live!
The Chairman freezes the transfer instantly and strips Marcus of his CEO title on the spot.
Wait—Claire! You just ruined us both! Look at the burner phone before they arrest me!
As detectives escort Marcus and Vanessa in for questioning (later released on bail pending investigation), the black burner phone on the table lights up—someone just seized Vanessa’s V 🖤 line!
Well played, Claire. I took Vanessa’s burner phone—too bad Marcus was only the decoy. Check your father’s safe tonight. — D.

nodes.headline: Marcus Was Only The Decoy...
nodes.teaser_text: Episode 5: You crack open your father's vault—and discover who "D." really is.

nodes.text: 1:12 AM · Hours after Marcus and Vanessa posted bail pending investigation, you dial the wedding date into your father’s study safe—and the steel bolt clicks open.
Claire, step away from that safe. It’s Damon—I’m still using Vanessa’s burner phone, and Marcus only signed what I forced him to sign.

nodes.caption: Wire Receipt: $12,400,000 routed from Vance Trust to Cayman Account #D-904.

nodes.text: Twelve million dollars?! That was my father's hospital buyout fund—and Vanessa's signature is on page two!
Damon promised he would erase my gambling debts if I got Marcus to sign the transfer.
Claire, don't trust either of them! I kept the second phone to record Damon's blackmail calls!

nodes.transcript: [whispering urgently] Listen—Damon is downstairs in the lobby right now with two men. Lock the study door and check the red folder!

nodes.text: He's lying, Claire! Open the red folder—there's a DNA report inside that changes everything!

nodes.prompt: Footsteps echo up the marble stairs. What do you grab first?

options.label: Open the red folder right now
options.player_reply_text: I'm opening the folder—and both of you are answering to me tonight.

options.label: Clone the bank ledger to the cloud first
options.player_reply_text: Too late to hide anything. I just uploaded every wire receipt to the prosecutor.

nodes.text: Look at the date on the DNA report, Claire... We aren't even full sisters. Damon is my real father!
VIP TWIST: The cloud upload triggers a live fraud freeze—locking Damon's $12.4M Cayman account mid-transfer!
Wait—the elevator just stopped on our floor! Claire, hide behind the bookshelf!
Too late, little bird. Hand over the second phone, and nobody gets hurt.

nodes.headline: The Study Door Opens...
nodes.teaser_text: Episode 6 (Season Finale): Face to face with the mastermind—one final move decides who walks out free.

nodes.text: 1:25 AM · The penthouse study. Marcus stands between you and the door while Vanessa trembles by the safe.
Give me the burner phone, Claire. Your father built this empire with my blood—I'm just taking my share.

nodes.caption: DNA Match 99.98%: Vanessa is Damon's biological daughter—used as his pawn from day one.

nodes.text: You told me Dad hated me... You used me to destroy my own sister?!
Claire, forgive me for hiding the burner phone—I thought I could protect you alone.
Touching speech. Now put the phone on the desk before I call security to erase the cameras.

nodes.transcript: [calm, ice-cold] Too bad the penthouse intercom has been live-streaming this room to the police and the board for five minutes.

nodes.text: Sirens! They're pulling into the driveway—Claire, finish this!

nodes.prompt: Damon lunges for the burner phone. Choose your Season Finale!

options.label: Trigger the panic lock until police arrive
options.player_reply_text: Lockdown engaged. Enjoy explaining the $12M wire to the federal prosecutor.

options.label: Redirect the $12M escrow back to your name
options.player_reply_text: Check your phone, Damon. I just reversed the Cayman wire into my father's trust.

nodes.text: NO! The doors are steel-locked—Vanessa, tell them I was coerced!
VIP FINALE: The escrow reversal hits your screen—$12.4M restored, and Damon's lawyer drops him on the spot!
I'm testifying against him, Claire. I don't expect forgiveness... I just hope you're finally safe.
The second phone is dead forever. If you ever give me one more chance, I'll spend my life earning it.

nodes.headline: The Dead Burner Buzzes Again...
nodes.teaser_text: Act 2 · Episode 7: As Damon is led out in cuffs, a hidden micro-SIM inside the burner activates—Damon was never the top of the chain.

nodes.text: 9:15 AM · Sunlit penthouse study. You pry open the dead burner's battery tray—and find a gold micro-SIM taped underneath. Instantly, it pings.
Damon failed. You have 48 hours to return the Vance Hospital Registry, Claire—or we trigger the 2019 Meridian clause.

nodes.caption: 2019 Meridian Merger Rider · Hidden Hostile-Takeover Clause Triggered Upon Board Insolvency ($40M Valuation).

nodes.text: Who is on this line?! Damon is in a holding cell—what is the Meridian Group?!
Claire, put that phone down! Meridian is the private syndicate that tried to swallow your father's clinics in 2019!

nodes.prompt: The encrypted SIM flashes a 48-hour countdown. What is your first move?

options.label: Trace the SIM carrier through your lawyer
options.player_reply_text: I'm sending this merger rider to our corporate counsel right now.

options.label: Decrypt the hidden 2019 signatory page

nodes.text: Don't send it to outside counsel yet—Meridian has moles on the board. Let me check the registry first.
SECRET UNLOCKED: The encrypted signatory page loads—and the witness signature next to Meridian's Chairman belongs to MARCUS!
Wait a second... why is Marcus suddenly so nervous about corporate counsel seeing the 2019 rider?
Check on your sister, Claire. Protective custody isn't as safe as the prosecutor promised.

nodes.headline: Vanessa's Tracker Just Went Dark...
nodes.teaser_text: Episode 8: Your sister disappears from witness protection—and calls you from a rain-soaked dock.

nodes.text: 8:10 PM · City neon reflects off the penthouse glass. The prosecutor's office just notified you that Vanessa's safe-house line is dead.
Vanessa, answer me! Where did the marshals move you?!
Vanessa whispers over howling wind: "Claire, I ran! Someone inside the prosecutor's office leaked my testimony to Meridian!"
You decline. A frantic voicemail transcribes: "Claire, Meridian bought the safe-house guard! I'm hiding near Pier 19!"
Listen to me—Damon isn't the boss. There's a Chairman at Meridian Tower, and he knows EVERY move we make!

nodes.prompt: Vanessa is terrified and off the grid. How do you respond?

options.label: Wire her cash & send a private driver
options.player_reply_text: Stay hidden—sending my trusted driver to Pier 19 now.

options.label: Ask who inside our circle works for Meridian
options.player_reply_text: Who leaked your safe-house address, Vanessa?

nodes.text: Thank you, sis. Don't tell Marcus where I am—not until you see what I found in his old calendar.
SECRET UNLOCKED: Vanessa gasps—"The leak came from an executive keycard issued to Suite 5001 at Meridian Tower... registered to MARCUS!"
Suite 5001?! Why would Marcus have a private suite at the exact syndicate trying to destroy us?!
Your husband kept more than one secret, Claire. Check your inbox.

nodes.headline: Suite 5001 At Meridian Tower...
nodes.teaser_text: Episode 9: A black keycard photo lands on your screen—booked under Marcus's personal name.

nodes.text: 9:45 PM · You pull Marcus's 2021 desk calendar from his study drawer. Four dates are circled in red ink: MERIDIAN.
Marcus told me he was in Zurich on all four of those nights...

nodes.caption: Meridian Tower Suite 5001 · Executive Keycard issued to Marcus Vance — Last swipe: 6 days ago at 11:58 PM.

nodes.text: Six days ago, Claire. Right before your anniversary. Ask your devoted husband what he traded in Suite 5001.
Six days ago?! He told me he was working late on the hospital merger!

nodes.prompt: Marcus's headlights pull into the driveway downstairs. Confront him?

options.label: Text him the Suite 5001 keycard coldly
options.player_reply_text: Care to explain Suite 5001 at Meridian Tower six days ago, Marcus?

options.label: Check his cufflink safe before he comes up

nodes.text: Claire—where did you get that photo?! Don't open another message from V until I get upstairs!
SECRET UNLOCKED: Beneath the velvet lining of his cufflink box lies a heavy silver signet ring engraved with the Meridian crest!
You swore the second phone was dead forever. You lied to my face again!
I'm coming up the stairs right now. Please—let me explain before you destroy us both.

nodes.headline: The Ally Turns Suspect...
nodes.teaser_text: Episode 10: Marcus deletes a panicked message—just before V 🖤 drops an audio recording that shatters everything.

nodes.text: 10:30 PM · Rain hammers the study windows. You lock the oak door from inside while Marcus pounds softly on the other side.
Don't come in until you tell me the truth about Suite 5001 and the Meridian crest!
If the Chairman finds out she saw the Suite 5001 card, my federal handler will pull the plug tonight.

nodes.transcript: [crisp boardroom recording — Marcus's voice] "Give me twenty million in escrow and the Vance Hospital patents are yours by Friday."

nodes.text: That's YOUR voice, Marcus!! Selling my father's hospital patents for twenty million dollars?!

nodes.prompt: Your heart stops. Did Marcus play you from the very beginning?

options.label: Demand he leave the house tonight
options.player_reply_text: Pack a bag and get out, Marcus. We are done.

options.label: Analyze the audio waveform for edits

nodes.text: Claire, listen to the background click—I was wearing a wire! I've been working undercover against Meridian for eight months!
SECRET UNLOCKED: Zooming into the audio file reveals a spliced timestamp—Meridian cut out the next sentence where Marcus signaled federal agents!
Claire, pick up! I just saw Marcus's signet ring in a photo from the prosecutor's leaked file—it has a micro-NFC chip inside!
A micro-NFC chip inside his ring?! Let me scan it right now...

nodes.headline: The Secret Inside The Ring...
nodes.teaser_text: Episode 11: Scanning the Meridian signet ring unlocks Marcus's hidden federal dossier—or proves his guilt forever.

nodes.text: 11:10 PM · You hold the heavy silver Meridian ring against your phone's NFC reader. An encrypted Justice Department badge file flashes open.

nodes.caption: Meridian Signet Ring · Embedded NFC Chip links to Federal Financial Crimes Case #FC-889 — Informant: M. Vance.

nodes.text: Marcus's voice cracks: "Damon framed me in 2021. The Feds gave me one choice—infiltrate Meridian's Chairman or watch you lose everything."
You decline. A shaky voicemail lands: "Tap the NFC file, Claire. I'm Informant FC-889—I was never selling your father's legacy."
I couldn't tell you because Meridian bugged our penthouse last winter. That's why I used a burner phone!

nodes.prompt: The federal case file looks real. Do you unlock the study door?

options.label: Unlock the door & verify his handler's ID
options.player_reply_text: Open the file with me right now—one more lie and you're gone.

options.label: Call the Justice Department verification line

nodes.text: Here—Agent Reyes's direct badge number. Call her yourself, Claire. We're on the same side.
SECRET UNLOCKED: Agent Reyes confirms Marcus's cover—AND warns you that Meridian just posted Damon's secret bail an hour ago!
Wait... if Damon is already out on bail, then Vanessa is walking straight into a trap!
CLAIRE!! Damon's men just found the Pier 19 warehouse! I'm running toward the water!

nodes.headline: Damon Is Out On Bail...
nodes.teaser_text: Episode 12: Vanessa's desperate voice note cuts off at the docks—and Meridian's fixer erases the board audit.

nodes.text: 12:15 AM · Sirens echo miles away across the harbor. You and Marcus speed toward Pier 19 as Vanessa's voice note loads.

nodes.transcript: [running footsteps, rain] Claire, I grabbed the prosecutor's briefcase before Damon's men broke in! The Chairman's real ledger is on Floor 50 at Meridian Tower!

nodes.text: Vanessa, stay hidden in the ferry terminal! Marcus and I are three minutes away!
I just called Agent Reyes—her office was raided by Meridian's bought-off Deputy Attorney! We're completely on our own tonight!
I'm safe in the ferry locker room! Come get me—and bring Marcus's Suite 5001 keycard!

nodes.prompt: You reach Pier 19 and pull Vanessa into the car. Where next?

options.label: Head straight to Meridian Tower Floor 50
options.player_reply_text: We're hitting Floor 50 before they shred the audit.

options.label: Copy the prosecutor's briefcase files first

nodes.text: Let's do it, sis. I owe you everything for tonight.
SECRET UNLOCKED: Inside the briefcase is the Chairman's private server password—giving you direct root access to Floor 50!
Touching family reunion, Claire. Too bad you just drove straight onto our private property.
Let them watch. This time, the three of us are walking in together.

nodes.headline: Infiltrating Meridian Tower
nodes.teaser_text: Episode 13: Floor 50 is pitch dark—until the elevator locks remotely and a 30-minute wipe begins.

nodes.text: 1:40 AM · Floor 50 of Meridian Tower. Glass walls overlook the sleeping city. Blue server lights hum behind the Chairman's mahogany desk.
I'm in the server terminal! Wait—there's an offshore liquidation script scheduled for 9:00 AM sharp!
That's the opening bell! They're going to liquidate Dad's entire hospital trust in seven hours!
Welcome to Floor 50, Claire. I just locked the executive elevators remotely. Enjoy the next thirty minutes.
CLANK. Steel security shutters drop over the elevator foyer, sealing the entire 50th floor.

nodes.prompt: The server console flashes: AUTO-WIPE IN 29:50. Act now!

options.label: Pull the physical backup drive from Rack A
options.player_reply_text: Grabbing the raw drive before the wipe completes!

options.label: Reroute the wipe to Meridian's own shells

nodes.text: Got the backup drive! Wait—Marcus, why are security boots coming up the fire stairs?!
SECRET UNLOCKED: Reversing the wipe script dumps Meridian's Cayman shell-company ledger straight into your cloud vault!
I'm at the stairwell door with two loyal federal agents! Open the manual override latch!
Wait... the Chairman just sent a file to the boardroom screen—that's my father's Zurich deed!

nodes.headline: The Zurich Liquidation Twist...
nodes.teaser_text: Episode 14: The Chairman plays his deadliest card—the original hospital deed is set to self-liquidate at 9:00 AM.

nodes.text: 2:30 AM · Marcus and Agent Reyes breach the stairwell door as the giant boardroom screen glows with a Zurich bank seal.
Claire, are you and Vanessa okay?! Did you get the ledger?
Keep your ledger, Claire. Your father's hospital deed sits in Zurich Vault #7—and without Damon's biometric key, it liquidates automatically at 9:00 AM.
Make sure Damon's biometric token stays in his penthouse safe until the jet takes off at 8:00.
Did you see that unsent text?! Damon's biometric token is still sitting in his penthouse safe!

nodes.prompt: Six hours until the $40M hospital trust vanishes forever!

options.label: Plan a dawn raid on Damon's penthouse
options.player_reply_text: We get that biometric token before Damon reaches the airport.

options.label: Freeze the Zurich escrow with Agent Reyes

nodes.text: Reyes can't get a Swiss court order before 9:00 AM. That biometric token is our only shot!
SECRET UNLOCKED: Agent Reyes places a 60-second emergency recall flag on Zurich Vault #7—giving you ONE tiny window if you bring the token!
I know Damon's penthouse safe code, Claire. Let me go get the token—I owe you this.
Dawn approaches over the skyline. One biometric key, one emergency proxy vote, and four hours left on the clock.

nodes.headline: Act 3: Countdown To Opening Bell
nodes.teaser_text: Episode 15: 5:10 AM — Meridian leaks a forged resignation letter under your name to crash the stock.

nodes.text: 5:10 AM · Pre-dawn traffic hums below as your phone explodes with financial news alerts.
Breaking news, Claire: "Vance Heiress Resigns Amid Fraud Probe." Your shares just dropped 38% in pre-market trading.
They forged my resignation letter to trigger the 2019 insolvency clause! That's how they steal the board vote!

nodes.transcript: [calm, focused] Don't panic, Claire. I'm locking in three loyal board directors right now. If Vanessa gets Damon's token, we crush them at 8:45.

nodes.text: I'm inside Damon's penthouse lobby now. Concierge still thinks I'm on his side—heading up to the 38th floor.

nodes.prompt: Pre-market shares are tanking fast. How do you counter?

options.label: Release a live video denying the resignation
options.player_reply_text: Going live to shareholders—that resignation is a forgery!

options.label: Leak Meridian's 2019 shell-company chart

nodes.text: Saw your video—the stock just bounced back 15%! Hang on, I'm dialing Damon's safe now...
SECRET UNLOCKED: Financial reporters pick up the Cayman shell chart in minutes—Meridian's own stock halts for regulatory review!
Be careful, Vanessa! Grab the token and get straight to the service elevator!
Got the biometric token! Wait... why did the penthouse hallway monitor just beep?!

nodes.headline: Armed Fixers In The Lobby...
nodes.teaser_text: Episode 16: Marcus intercepts the penthouse CCTV—two Meridian fixers are riding up to trap Vanessa.

nodes.text: 6:40 AM · Morning fog wraps the skyscrapers. Vanessa's dot blinks red on Floor 38.
Claire, the main elevator just stopped on my floor! I can hear two men checking the corridor!

nodes.caption: Penthouse Lobby CCTV (6:40 AM) · Two armed Meridian fixers stepping off the private lift on Floor 38.

nodes.text: Vanessa, DO NOT use the elevators! Take the laundry chute corridor to the rooftop helipad stairwell!
Hold on, Vanessa—Marcus and I are pulling up to the back loading dock right now!

nodes.prompt: The fixers are ten feet from Damon's study door!

options.label: Guide Vanessa down the service stairs
options.player_reply_text: Left at the ice machine—service stairs straight to B1!

options.label: Trigger the VIP fire lockdown remotely

nodes.text: I'm in the stairwell running flat-out—I have the biometric token zipped in my coat!
SECRET UNLOCKED: The VIP fire lockdown traps both fixers inside the penthouse foyer while Vanessa breezes out to the loading dock!
I'm in your car! Here—take the token, Claire. Let's end Damon for good.
Smart move, little bird. Now answer your phone before I bury your husband's career on live TV.

nodes.headline: Damon Calls From The Runway...
nodes.teaser_text: Episode 17: Damon threatens to blow Marcus's federal cover unless you sign away your voting shares.

nodes.text: 7:50 AM · One hour before the emergency board vote. Your burner rings with a roaring jet engine in the background.
He's already on the private tarmac! Put him on speaker—Agent Reyes is tracing the tower!
Damon sneers over jet turbines: "Sign over your proxy shares in ten minutes, Claire—or I leak Marcus's undercover wiretaps to the cartel!"
You decline. Damon's furious voicemail hits instantly: "Sign the proxy or Marcus's federal identity hits every darknet forum at 8:30!"
Choose wisely, Claire: your father's hospital empire—or your husband's life.

nodes.prompt: Damon's private jet is taxiing onto Runway 4. Your call!

options.label: Keep him talking so Reyes grounds the jet
options.player_reply_text: Send the proxy link, Damon—I need to read clause four.

options.label: Bluff that the Chairman already flipped on him

nodes.text: Reyes just got the FAA ground-stop order! His jet isn't leaving that runway!
SECRET UNLOCKED: Damon panics and blurts out the Chairman's Swiss routing code on your recorded line—sealing BOTH their indictments!
Keep your threats, Damon. I'm walking into the boardroom right now.
You step through the tall glass doors of Vance Tower as every camera in the lobby turns toward you.

nodes.headline: 8:45 AM — The Live Proxy Vote
nodes.teaser_text: Episode 18: Twelve directors, one biometric key, and the final showdown for your father's legacy.

nodes.text: 8:45 AM · The 60th-floor boardroom is packed. Meridian's Chairman sits at the head of the table, smiling coldly.
Good morning, Directors. I did not resign—and I brought Damon's biometric key plus eight months of federal wiretaps.
Security! Escort her out—the 2019 Meridian merger vote is already finalized!

nodes.transcript: [steady, commanding] Too late, Chairman. Every shareholder on this live stream is looking at your Cayman shell transfers right now.

nodes.text: Three board members just flipped to our side! We have the majority vote, Claire!

nodes.prompt: The Chairman reaches for his tablet to trigger the Zurich wire early!

options.label: Call the roll-call vote to strip his seat
options.player_reply_text: All in favor of voiding the Meridian rider, raise your hands!

options.label: Broadcast Marcus's undercover wiretap live

nodes.text: You can void the board vote all you want—Damon just hit execute on the $40M Zurich liquidation from the tarmac!
SECRET UNLOCKED: The Chairman's own recorded bribery order plays across the boardroom—and federal marshals step through the doors!
Claire! The Zurich bank screen just flashed RED—we have SIXTY SECONDS to trigger the recall with Damon's biometric token!
00:59... 00:58... The $40M hospital trust is draining out of Zurich Vault #7 in real time!

nodes.headline: 60 Seconds To Save $40 Million
nodes.teaser_text: Episode 19: Race the final countdown as Damon's jet is surrounded and the bank recall window closes.

nodes.text: 9:00 AM · Opening bell rings. Every eye in the boardroom locks onto the glowing recall countdown: 00:42.
You're too slow, Claire! Once that clock hits zero, your father's hospital fund is gone forever!
Plug Damon's biometric token into the console! Agent Reyes just unlocked the Zurich recall portal!
I'm reading out the override checksum from the prosecutor's file: 8-4-9-2-VANCE! Hit confirm, Claire!
00:12... 00:11... The confirmation screen demands one final authorization.

nodes.prompt: Ten seconds left! Finish the recall and end Meridian forever!

options.label: Execute the recall & lock the trust permanently
options.player_reply_text: Override confirmed—bring my father's trust home!

options.label: Freeze Meridian's $40M collateral as damages

nodes.text: NO!! The runway is blocked by federal vans—and the wire just bounced back to Vance Trust!
SECRET UNLOCKED: Not only does the $40M return intact—the federal court freezes Meridian's own collateral to fund three new charity wards!
00:03 remaining... TRANSFER REVERSED. $40,000,000 secured permanently in the Vance Hospital Trust.
Applause erupts across the 60th floor as marshals escort Meridian's Chairman away in cuffs.

nodes.headline: The Second Phone Goes Silent...
nodes.teaser_text: Episode 20 (Grand Finale): Sunlit morning returns—and you choose what comes next for your heart and your empire.

nodes.text: 10:30 AM · Bright morning sun pours across the penthouse terrace. Damon and Meridian's Chairman are both in federal custody.
I'm heading to the courthouse to sign my reduced plea deal, Claire. Thank you for never giving up on me.
You risked everything at Damon's penthouse to save Dad's trust. When you walk out, I'll be waiting, sis.
I threw the burner phone into the evidence bin for good. Here—a brand-new phone, with only one number saved in it.
You look out over the sunlit city, holding the keys to your father's hospital foundation—finally free of every shadow.

nodes.prompt: A brand-new chapter begins under clear skies. Choose your Grand Finale!

options.label: Take Marcus's hand & start fresh together
options.player_reply_text: No more secrets, Marcus. Happy new beginning.

options.label: Name the new hospital wing after your father

nodes.text: Marcus smiles warmly and pulls you close on the sunlit terrace—the long night is finally behind you both.
VIP FINALE: At the ribbon-cutting, you dedicate the Vance Memorial Wing with Marcus by your side—and Vanessa watching proudly on video.
No second phones. No hidden ledgers. Just the truth—and a future that belongs to me.
Your new phone chimes softly once with a calendar reminder: "Anniversary Dinner — Just Us."

nodes.headline: One Phone. One Truth. Forever.
